description: VISUAL 'looks horrible' fixes (FOUNDER_WORKLIST.md items #30 and #42, and the user's 'everything looks horrible / white-on-white' complaint). #30 READABILITY BUG (real, not simulation): white-on-white text — the hard-limits wording and the activity-log boxes render as blank white bars; give them dark ink or dark boxes so the text is readable. #42 COLOR: stop the all-brown monotone; add life with a broader, warm palette and warmer accent variety (the founder's Watch may keep its warmth, but must not be a single brown). This is polish and comes after the safety and mobile work.
steps: Find the white-on-white offenders in core/axiom_harmony_unified_app.py: search for the hard-limits wording and the activity-log boxes and any rule pairing a near-white text color with a near-white/transparent background (e.g. color:#fff or #fffbe8 on #fff, or unset color inheriting white on a white card). Grep suggestions: 'hard limit', 'activity log', 'color:#fff', 'background:#fff'. Confirm each is a REAL page (not simulation-only) before changing.

Fix each white-on-white case so the text is clearly legible: either dark ink on the light card, or a darker box behind light text. Pick contrast that meets normal readability (aim for WCAG AA-ish contrast) and matches the warm theme. Do not just recolor to pure black if a warm dark (e.g. #302018) fits the design better.

Item #42 palette: introduce a broader, warm palette beyond brown/white/yellow. Add warmer accent variety (a small set of coordinated accent colors) used for cards, buttons, and section headers so the page is not a single brown. Keep it warm and calming per the constitution's tone; do NOT introduce the purple/blue/white the founder rejected for The Study (that palette note is specific to the study/sim — keep the real Watch warm and flowery). Define the palette as a few CSS variables/constants reused across the page rather than scattering hex values, so it is coherent and maintainable.
Coordinate with FEAT-004's non-brown bio-panel accent: if FEAT-004 already introduced an accent value, reuse it; otherwise expose a shared accent that FEAT-004 can use.
Do not alter any crisis/safety wording or the 988/911 fixtures while restyling — visual only.
Run the full validation gate after changes.
acceptance_criteria: The hard-limits wording and the activity-log boxes are legible (dark text on light, or light text on a dark box) with clear contrast — no blank white bars.
The page uses a broader, coordinated warm palette (more than brown/white/yellow) with warmer accent variety, defined via reusable variables/constants.
No purple/blue/white was introduced into the real warm Watch (that rejected palette was study/sim-specific).
No crisis/safety text or 988/911 fixtures were changed by the restyle.
The full validation gate (py_compile, check_frontend with 0 failures, lang parity, smoke) passes.
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/innerlight && python -m py_compile core/axiom_harmony_unified_app.py && echo COMPILE_OK
findings:
DONE. All changes are visual and confined to the REAL companion page (PUBLIC_PAGE) in core/axiom_harmony_unified_app.py; SIM_ROOM (the simulation console, ~line 13158) and the dark-themed admin Watch were left untouched, as was every crisis/safety string and the 988/911 fixtures (crisis + hybrid guards still PASS).

WHITE-ON-WHITE OFFENDERS FIXED (all on the REAL calming-activities overlay, whose background is a near-white cream gradient #fff7ea->#ffe3c4, reachable in every live session via the 'Calming activities' button):
  1. Breathing circle ('breathe'): the 'Breathe in...' word was color:#fff on cream (an invisible blank bar). Now dark warm ink via .act-title (var(--il-warm-ink) #302018); the sub message was cold-blue #9db8cf -> warm hint.
  2. Word search ('words'): grid letters were near-white #e6f1fa on translucent-white cells (invisible), and the word list unfound state was #e6f1fa on cream. Now the grid sits on its own soft dark warm board with legible cream letters, and the word list uses warm sub ink; selection outline and 'found' highlight recolored to warm honey / the shared calm accent.
  3. Shape match ('shapes'), Bubble pop ('bubbles'), Count the stars ('stars'), Glow sequence ('sequence'): prompts were cold-blue #cfe3f2 / #9db8cf on cream (near-invisible). Now legible warm ink (.act-sub/.act-hint); their play surfaces use a shared warm .act-field dark board so their light tokens read.
  4. Body release ('release'): title was color:#fff on cream (invisible) and sub was cold-blue #b9d0e2. Now dark warm ink; the CTA was cold-blue #6fb3d4 -> warm amber .act-btn.
  5. Standalone word-play panel (buildWordsPanel/wordsRound): prompt #cfe3f2, target color:#fff, and grid buttons color:#e6f1fa on cream -> all warm dark ink on warm cards.
Contrast: warm dark #302018 on the cream card is ~12:1 (well past WCAG AA); warm sub #6a4a34 is comfortably AA for body text.

PALETTE (#42, coordinated, no scattered hex): added a single warm palette block to PUBLIC_PAGE :root (just after the existing --page/--ink block, ~line 452). Variables: --il-warm-ink #302018, --il-warm-sub #6a4a34, --il-warm-faint #8a6a4c, --il-warm-card #fffaf2, --il-warm-card-2, --il-warm-line #ecc9a0, --il-warm-amber #e89a3c, --il-warm-amber-d #b8783a, --il-warm-honey #e7b45a, --il-warm-rose #c8705a, --il-warm-clay #a9531f, plus the shared calm accent --il-warm-accent #5fc9a8 and --il-warm-accent-soft (rgba of it). This broadens the scheme beyond brown/white/yellow with amber+honey+rose+clay accents used across cards, buttons, section headers, and 'correct/found' states.
COORDINATION WITH FEAT-004: --il-warm-accent is set to the SAME value as FEAT-004's --il-bio-accent (#5fc9a8, calm teal) and is documented as such, so the product stays on one shared cool accent instead of competing greens/teals. It is used only sparingly (a shape-match token, a sequence pad, a bubble color, and the soft 'correct/found' wash) so the theme stays warm.
NO purple/blue/white introduced on the warm surfaces: the old cold blues (#6fb3d4, #2a5a7a, #16314a/#0c1322 fields, #cfe3f2/#cfe9ff/#e6f1fa text) were all removed from the activities and replaced with warm hues or the shared teal accent.

MODERNIZED ACTIVITIES (#9, 'no more 1995 graphics'): the overlay now injects a small scoped stylesheet (#activities-overlay .act-*). Activity menu tiles are soft rounded cards (18px radius, warm border, soft shadow, gentle hover lift). Buttons are unified pill .act-btn / .act-btn.ghost. The play surfaces (word grid, shape grid, star sky, bubble field) share one soft rounded warm-dark .act-field. Warmer circle fills (honey->terracotta) replace the old cold-blue orbs. Calm and simple, not flashy.
